description: This Java source file defines the class 'PlaceholderFilter', which provides static methods for handling placeholder replacement within strings, particularly in the context of authorization and template processing. It includes functionalities for applying placeholders, validating templates, and resolving expressions with support for pipelines and fallback strategies.

classes.name: PlaceholderFilter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for applying and validating placeholders within templates and strings, primarily used for authorization contexts and template processing.

methods.name: applyHeadersPlaceholderToAuthContext
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in AuthorizationContext using provided headers and returns a new AuthorizationContext with substituted values.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a template string using a placeholder source and a placeholder definition, returning the resolved string.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a template string using an ExpressionResolver, returning the resolved string.

methods.name: applyOrElseDelete
methods.description: Resolves placeholders in a template string and returns an Optional with the result or empty if resolution fails or element is deleted.

methods.name: applyOrElseRetain
methods.description: Resolves placeholders in a template string and returns the result or the original string if resolution fails.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the template string's placeholders can be fully resolved using provided placeholders.

methods.name: validateAndReplace
methods.description: Validates the template with placeholders replaced by a dummy string and returns the fully resolved string without placeholders.
